title_zh: 三站空间剖面与服务蓝图
title_en: Three Station Sections and Service Blueprints

stations.design_question_zh: 研发和居住怎样相邻而不把实验风险带进私宅？
stations.design_question_en: How can research and living sit near each other without carrying laboratory risk into private homes?
relative_plan: public green approach and ordinary entrance
human option desk and project-housing threshold
controlled lab edge with independent access
quiet residential edge and reversible fit-out mock-up

concept_section.critical_separation: private domestic access, controlled lab access and maintenance access remain distinct

movement.ordinary_route: green approach -> human desk -> shared courtyard -> approved destination
movement.accessible_route: step-free approach with resting and assisted-service points, subject to field audit
movement.service_route: separate timed delivery, maintenance and emergency access, subject to professional confirmation

service_blueprint.backstage: housing and workspace sources checked separately
operator monitors only declared operational data

service_blueprint.user_action: return access and choose future contact

stations.design_question_zh: 家庭阶段变化时，怎样转换户型、照护和工作而不被平台评分？
stations.design_question_en: How can layout, care and work change with a household stage without platform scoring?
relative_plan: quiet neighborhood approach and no-app entrance
adaptable-home mock-up around a shared courtyard
private threshold with default-deny device boundary

vertical_logic: human service and ordinary access at ground
concept_section.critical_separation: the public service porch stops before the resident-controlled private threshold

movement.ordinary_route: neighborhood entrance -> human care/service porch -> chosen service or home threshold
movement.accessible_route: continuous step-free route, seating, low-sensory waiting and assisted communication, subject to field audit
movement.service_route: appointment-based care, repair and reversible-fit-out access controlled by resident consent

service_blueprint.user_action: describe a family-stage need without diagnostic labeling
service_blueprint.frontstage: staff lists separate care, work and layout paths
service_blueprint.backstage: minimum fields and applicable rights reviewed
service_blueprint.fallback: in-person or home-visit arrangement if authorized

service_blueprint.user_action: choose who may enter or receive data
service_blueprint.backstage: property, safety and data roles sign separately
service_blueprint.fallback: keep existing layout and ordinary service

service_blueprint.user_action: observe reversible change or service handover
service_blueprint.backstage: component, access and incident registers maintained
deletion, repair and receiving role close the case

stations.design_question_zh: 初次抵达者怎样看见多种选择、人工责任和普通路径，而不是被导向唯一推荐？
stations.design_question_en: How can a newcomer see multiple choices, accountable people and ordinary routes rather than one recommended path?
relative_plan: four-direction arrival approach subject to transport survey
first-key landmark and bilingual human desk
option hall with ordinary and accessible waiting

vertical_logic: building intensity and rail relation unknown
concept_section.critical_separation: commercial display, housing advice and public-service eligibility decisions remain visibly separate

movement.ordinary_route: arrival approach -> first key -> human desk -> chosen receiving point
movement.accessible_route: step-free four-direction route with seated waiting and staff assistance, subject to field audit
movement.service_route: maintenance and deliveries avoid primary waiting and through movement, subject to traffic and fire review

service_blueprint.frontstage: staff shows several current options and unknowns
separate housing, workspace and service queues
service_blueprint.backstage: no cross-use of protected decision data
reason and next ordinary option recorded

service_blueprint.fallback: close and preserve a returnable entry
